title: Diary Of A CEO Responded To My Takedown. I Wasn't Ready For This
chapters: 0:18:02 Beneath New Culture Is Old Psychology
0:41:19 The view from the other side
1:00:17 The antidote to all of this
desc_head:
Steven Bartlett replied to my clip about Diary of a CEO. 
At half past midnight. 
Edited.

Do you know Steven Bartlett? 
Not know of him. 
Know him?
Most of us feel like we do. We know his voice, the lean-forward, the frown before he disagrees. And we've never met him. 

This video is about why our brains can't tell the difference, and what that same wiring does to a man that 50 million people are watching.

It started because I wanted to take the Mickey. Then I read the research, and the piss-take died in my hands.

Original Diary of a CEO video:    • Diary Of A CEO Is Making You Less Success

comments.text: I noticed something refreshing about this show: Barry ( my new parasocial bestie ;) hasn’t begged me to subscribe. No “my team noticed…” speech, no subscription intervention, no guilt trip. Apparently you can just make a good show and let people decide for themselves. 😂 What a concept!
This was a great video by my close personal friend Barry who I am extremely close with
This is the comedy act with the most peer-reviewed scientific studies mentioned that I’ve ever seen. I absolutely love it.

At first I wanted to comment on what a powerful message this is, and then I decided not to because I didn't want to just be performing for the other commenters, and then I decided to because I should be my authentic self, but I didn't want to because I'm just perpetuating the illusion that any of us actually know each other. And then I decided that this would make a mildly funny bit so here it is.

Your snarky response;  “How do I know it’s Steven Bartlett, you haven’t mentioned Huel”.
ABSOLUTELY SAVAGE 😱🤣
I cold plunge my dog genuinely made me laugh
Someone that makes $45mil a year just having a chat with other rich people is the snakiest of oils.
The ending of this being so absolutely uncomfortable while also being a metaphorical mirror being held up to the populous of the internet… it is masterful.
I don’t think you hurt his feelings, I think you threatened his brand.
Diarrhea of a CEO
The Huel joke is gold

I decided to watch because i found it strange to be in a disagreement with Steven from Diary of a CEO of all ppl lol and I am so glad I did!! Everyone needs to see this, it should be like a freakin PSA with how constant social media access is honestly chipping away at our society's ability to have basic human connection. Beautifully done.

Barry, I don't know how you stare blankly at a camera and talk for hours to make a 60 minute philosophical masterpiece like this, nevermind all the writing effort.  Thank you for being gold in a mountain of sewage
I'm an amateur psychologist with a BS degree to prove it. Your content mines the psychology archives like the dwarves of Moria. I reserve some awe for you, Barry.
If Steven doesn't realise he's a grifter that's on him 😂

There's some random person out there called Steven who fell asleep with this playing all the way to the end and had a nightmare sleep paralysis episode about being in a coma while people try to reach him

I'm just so happy this channel exists. I clicked on expecting fun and drama about the DOAC reaction, instead got a trip into evolution neurobiology I didn't know I needed (I work in the media, so understanding the hard science between these phenomenons is super beneficial).

This is the right use of the clickbait. Thank you, Barry!

Steven Bartlett showed how in-touch he is when on Dragon's Den he complained about a health product by saying "I get these sent to me all the time", thus indicating that customers wouldn't buy one. The entrepreneur had to remind him: not everyone gets free products sent to their doorstep every day...?
“Why did the Emperor reply to the graffiti?” — great line, Level 3 friend.
You absolutely floored me with "screaming into a sachet of Huel" figuratively pissed myself laughing 👌
